prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results.
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Reordering sign-in showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose_path layout changes did not improve conversion across 2 tests, with major changes hurting performance.
Evidence is still thin for adoption/new_screen, choose_path/copy, choose_path/hint, choose_path/redesign, finish/hint, finish/layout, finish/redesign, home/hint, home/notification, sign_in/copy, and sign_in/redesign, as each has only 1 test.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Add Custom Pet Style Selector Screen: Insert an art style selection screen before uploading photos so users can set their preferred companion visual style. (why: Adoption has a steep drop (60.9% conversion) and support reported custom pets looking wrong or failing (3 emails).)
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Photo Upload Stage with Live Quality Check Grid: Redesign the upload photos screen with a structured grid layout and interactive photo requirements checklist. (why: Custom pet generation fails or results look wrong for multiple users (3 support emails) and adoption has low conversion.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Quick Start Calibration Flow: Add an interactive desktop visibility and key shortcut test module on the final onboarding screen. (why: Support emails highlight confusion on controlling/hiding pets (3 emails) and pets failing to render on desktop (3 emails).)
3: [home, redesign] Redesign Waiting Screen with Interactive Mini Pet Playground: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout showing animated mascot interactions while generation completes. (why: Home step has extreme waiting times (median 201s, mean 2336s). Entertaining users during generation reduces drop-off.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Companion Path Selection Decision Hint: Add an inline hint clarifying that path choices are flexible and can be changed later. (why: Users spend a very long mean time (514s) on path selection due to decision hesitation.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Warning Hint: Add explicit warning text on the sign-in screen urging returning users to sign in with their original provider. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complain about lost pets after signing in under a different account.)
6: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Vault Pet Backup Sign-In Incentive: Update sign-in screen headline and body to emphasize automated cloud pet backups and multi-device sync. (why: Sign-in step drops 27.1% of users, and account sync issues cause severe post-onboarding pet loss support tickets.)
7: [adoption, copy] Custom Pet Generation Clarity Copy: Update photo upload text to clearly explain what type of photos produce the best custom pet generation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low (60.9%).)
8: [finish, copy] Essential Desktop Controls Copy Guidance: Update the home intro text with explicit key shortcuts and right-click interaction instructions. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to hide, show, or control the pet.)

scores.note: New screens in adoption step previously hurt conversion (-2.1%).

Adding interactive modules on finish adds friction, matching negative trends for finish redesigns.
Waiting screen changes across 3 tests showed no clear positive effect.
Inline hints on choose_path previously produced +3.6% lift with zero dev cost.
Directly targets top support complaint (8 emails) via quick copy warning.
Sign-in copy updates show mild positive trend (+0.5%) and carry minimal risk.
High drop step; copy changes avoid the negative performance of adoption redesigns.
